theme_central: "Explained in detail": the nature of divine revelation and the human response to it — from the testimony of the skin of the damned to the recommendation to answer evil with good.
sources_note: Division into 6 rukus precisely sourced (normalbeaconite.blogspot.com), boundaries at verses 8, 18, 25, 32, 44, 54.

branches.title: Divine origin of the Qur'an
branches.resume: Revelation in clear Arabic, detailed, to warn and to announce good news.

children.t: The Qur'an, a revelation detailed in clear Arabic

branches.title: Stages of creation, 'Ad and Thamud
branches.resume: Earth and heavens created in six days by stages; brief reminder of 'Ad and Thamud destroyed.

children.t: Earth and heavens created in six stages, stars as adornment and protection
Brief reminder of 'Ad and Thamud, destroyed for rejecting the message

branches.title: Scene of the Judgment
branches.resume: Skin, hearing and sight testifying against the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment.

children.t: Skin testifying against the disbelievers, evil companions who misled them

branches.title: Warning, comfort of the steadfast
branches.resume: Those who make noise to drown out the recitation; the angels reassure the steadfast believers.

children.t: Noise to drown out the recitation; angels reassuring the steadfast believers

branches.title: Answering evil with good
branches.resume: Repelling evil with what is better turns the enemy into a close friend; the Qur'an a healing for the believers.

children.t: Repelling evil with good, the enemy becomes a close friend
Signs of night and day, the Qur'an a healing for the believers

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Ancient disagreements over the Book, signs on the horizon and within oneself until the truth becomes evident.

children.t: Ancient disagreements over the Book given to Musa
Signs shown on the horizon and within oneself until the truth becomes evident
